connectors.refdes: LCD module cable · optional USART3 direct-serial breakout
connectors.scope: Klipper upstream CR-30 2021 sample config describes an optional USART3 breakout on the 10-pin IDC cable used by the LCD module: source positions 3 Tx, 4 Rx, 9 GND and 10 VCC. The 2021 configuration and installed controller are not verified; VCC voltage, other position functions, mating-face orientation and external SmoothieBox compatibility are unknown.
